Your 2027 Medicare track

Every MSSP track and LEAD can bill B2 (32%).

3QP in 2024 and 2025?

QP status sets the conversion factor two years later: 2024 for 2026, 2025 for 2027. One answer applies to both; a change between those years isn’t modeled.

Why these questions?

B1 or B2. B2 (32%) is limited to MSSP ACOs, in any track, and the LEAD model. Everyone else billing for complexity uses B1 (16%), including other Advanced APMs.

Conversion factor. QP status runs two years ahead: 2024 QPs get the QP rate in 2026 ($33.5675 vs $33.4009 per RVU), and 2025 QPs get it in 2027 ($32.9548 vs $32.6286). The model uses one answer for both years, so if you became a QP only in 2025, its 2026 baseline is slightly too high. It applies to the TIN where you were a QP.

Each answer defaults to the lower-paying option. Compare all four outcomes in the 2026 → 2027 panel.

What changes from 2026 to 2027

Monthly Medicare payment with the same visits and mix in both years, after the 2% sequestration. 2027 fees are scheduled; 2027 inflation is projected.

PCP monthly payment over the years

National Medicare allowed amounts, including the 20% patient share, after the 2% sequestration on Medicare’s share. MEI-adjusted values account for growth in practice costs.

List of policy events

    Chart notes

    What MEI measures; early-year shading; data vintages

    MEI: the Medicare Economic Index of practice costs, as CMS publishes it (net of a productivity adjustment). It rose 59% from 2001 to 2025.

    Shaded through 1995: national reference values, without the local charge-transition blending that applied then. 2026 uses the January 2026 RVU file. The 2025 CPI averages 11 months; October 2025 was not published.

    Methods & sources

    Payment model, sequestration, APCM, B1/B2, inflation adjustment, historical pricing and data

    Abbreviations

    37 terms, ACO to TIN
    • ACO: Accountable Care Organization
    • APCM: Advanced Primary Care Management (monthly codes G0556–G0558)
    • APM: Alternative Payment Model
    • AWV: Annual Wellness Visit
    • B1 / B2: 2027 complexity modifiers worth 16% / 32% of the E/M visit’s full fee
    • BLS: Bureau of Labor Statistics
    • CAA 2021: Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2021
    • CARES Act: Coronavirus Aid, Relief, and Economic Security Act
    • CBO: Congressional Budget Office
    • CF: conversion factor: dollars per RVU (fee = total RVUs × CF)
    • CMS: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services
    • CPI: Consumer Price Index
    • CSV: comma-separated values (spreadsheet download)
    • CY: calendar year
    • E/M: evaluation and management (office visit codes 99202–99215)
    • EOM: Enhancing Oncology Model
    • FFS: fee-for-service
    • G2211: visit-complexity add-on code, 2024–2026
    • HCFA: Health Care Financing Administration (CMS before 2001)
    • KCC: Kidney Care Choices model
    • L3 / L4: visit level 3 / level 4
    • LEAD: Long-term Enhanced ACO Design model
    • MACRA: Medicare Access and CHIP Reauthorization Act of 2015
    • MEI: Medicare Economic Index
    • MIPPA: Medicare Improvements for Patients and Providers Act of 2008
    • MIPS: Merit-based Incentive Payment System
    • MP: malpractice (professional liability) RVUs
    • MSSP: Medicare Shared Savings Program
    • PC Flex: ACO Primary Care Flex model
    • PCP: primary care provider
    • PE: practice expense: practice overhead
    • QMB: Qualified Medicare Beneficiary
    • QP: Qualifying APM Participant
    • RVU: relative value unit
    • SGR: sustainable growth rate
    • TCM: transitional care management
    • TIN: Taxpayer Identification Number
